signIn.welcomeDescription: Sign in with your account to continue.
signIn.firstRunDescription: This copy is yours. The account you make here is the workspace owner.
signIn.closedDescription: This CRM has no sign-in method configured, so nobody can get in — including you.
signIn.closedHelp: Set GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET — or MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID and MICROSOFT_CLIENT_SECRET — in the root .env file and restart. Your own identity provider can be added from Settings once somebody is signed in.
signIn.name: Your name
signIn.passwordHint: At least {count} characters. It is stored on this computer only, and there is no way to reset it by email.
signIn.unreachable: Could not reach the sign-in service.

language.title: Language
language.description: The language this CRM speaks to you in.
language.label: Interface language
language.hint: New installs follow your operating system. This choice is remembered on this computer.

create.title: New company

create.name: Name

bulk.deleteDescription: Their contacts stay, with no company. Deals on these companies go with them, and none of it can be undone.
bulk.enriching: Looking up {count, plural, =1 {1 company} other {# companies}} — the table will update.

create.title: New contact
create.description: Email addresses are unique, so importing the same person twice updates them rather than duplicating them.

bulk.enriching: Looking up {count, plural, =1 {1 contact} other {# contacts}} — the table will update.

page.title: Deals
page.description: The pipeline, and everything that has already closed.

create.description: Every deal belongs to a company and has someone's name against it.
create.name: Name

bulk.reasonShared: The same reason goes on every one of them, so keep it to what they have in common.
bulk.closeLost: Close {count, plural, =1 {1 deal} other {# deals}} as lost
bulk.markUnqualified: Mark {count, plural, =1 {1 deal} other {# deals}} as unqualified
bulk.deleteDescription: Everything filed against them — activity, notes, the amounts in your pipeline — goes too. This cannot be undone.

company.name: Name
company.noContactsDescription: Everyone you talk to at {name} lives here — add the first person and their calls, emails and notes hang off them.
company.noDealsDescription: Nothing is being sold to {name} right now. Open one and it joins the pipeline and the forecast.
company.deleteDeals: {count, plural, =0 {Everything filed against the account goes too.} =1 {Its one deal and everything filed against the account go too.} other {All # of its deals and everything filed against the account go too.}}
company.deleteContacts: {count, plural, =1 {The one person who works there stays in the CRM, without a company.} other {The # people who work there stay in the CRM, without a company.}}

contact.deleteConsequence: Their notes, agent conversations and everything the agent found go too; emails and meetings stay filed against the company.
contact.deleteSuppressed: The sync will not bring {email} back — only adding them yourself will.

deal.name: Name
